entities.summary: Nepal is a sovereign nation in South Asia, Asia. Its capital is Kathmandu. Official languages include Nepali. Government: Federal parliamentary republic. Population: approximately 30.9 million. Area: 147,516 km². Comprehensive index for Nepal covering ancient Kirat dynasty, Licchavi era, medieval Malla kingdoms (Kathmandu/Patan/Bhaktapur), Prithvi Narayan Shah's unification 1768, Gorkha expansionism, Anglo-Nepalese War 1814-16 (Gurkha reputation), Rana oligarchy 1846-1951, monarchy restoration, Panchayat system, Maoist insurgency 1996-2006, royal massacre 2001, abolition of monarchy 2008, federal democratic republic, earthquakes, and India-China geopolitical balancing.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Nepal's unification in 1768 under Prithvi Narayan Shah had significant regional implications, leading to the expansion of the Gorkha kingdom and cementing Nepal's position as a major power in South Asia. This event also contributed to the Anglo-Nepalese War and the subsequent Rana oligarchy.
